{{Top|leg}}
'''Grubber''' was a common slang term to refer to an individual of ill repute.

==Usage==
*[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Hugo Treece]] told his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] not to come back until they had [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] ashes while calling him a "grubber".<ref name="SW56">[[Star Wars (1977) 56|''Star Wars'' (1977) 56]]</ref>
*One of the guards that detained [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and Lando Calrissian on [[Bazarre]] referred to the pair as "grubbers."
*[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mils Giel]] referred to a [[Unidentified Imperial deck officer (Helmsman)|member]] of his crew by this name, when he caught him ignoring the proper protocols on board the [[Helmsman (battlecruiser)|''Helmsman'']].
*[[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Fenn Shysa]] also used this insult when referring to the [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Fenn Shysa)|leader]] of a band of [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] outside the city of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]].
*The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] guard, [[Alph (guard)|Alph]] used this insult to humiliate a [[Unidentified Mandalorian (City of Bone)|Mandalorian enslaved worker]] that he was torturing in the [[City of Bone]].
*Patrons of a backwater world [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] used this insult to refer to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], after they became convinced that he had cheated them out of their money.
